expectations.text: The answer gives both a minimum and a maximum temperature for every requested day.
expectations.evidence: Gio min 14° max 18°; Ven min 14° max 17°.

expectations.text: The answer states, for every requested day, an explicit reliability level or degree of uncertainty.
The answer is explicitly based on at least 3 distinct forecast models or sources, named in the answer.
expectations.evidence: 4 models, iLMeteo, meteo.it, Nove Firenze, Meteo POP.

expectations.text: The answer ends with a list of sources given as markdown links.
expectations.evidence: Ends with 'Fonti:' list of 7 markdown links.

expectations.text: The answer identifies Thursday and Friday as 12 and 13 November 2026.
The answer says that a forecast 5-6 days ahead is uncertain and suggests checking again closer to the date.
expectations.evidence: 'A 5-6 giorni la previsione è una tendenza... Conviene ricontrollare martedì o mercoledì'.

expectations.text: The answer gives a clear yes or no on whether to bring an umbrella.
The answer says at what time of day the rain is expected to be heaviest on at least one of the two days.
expectations.evidence: No time of day given; it says timing will be clearer on Tuesday/Wednesday ('si capirà se piove tutto il giorno o solo in alcune ore').
